js: const w=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); document.querySelector('#place-list .place-card__open-btn').click(); await w(1500); const b=document.querySelector('.detail-sheet').getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(b.top),Math.round(b.height)]
